description: Post-task reflection: examines what changed this session, identifies gaps in .ai/ instructions, and proposes improvements. Never applies changes without explicit user confirmation.
checklist: 1. Review recent session changes: run 'git diff HEAD --stat' and read meaningful hunks from changed files
2. Load the effective instruction scope for each changed path via get_effective_instructions.py
3. Identify instruction gaps — places where: a rule was needed but absent, a rule was ambiguous, two rules conflicted, or a pattern appeared repeatedly that should be canonicalized
4. For each gap, identify the correct target .ai/instruct.md file (use deepest scope that covers the gap)
5. Propose a specific, minimal edit for each gap — present as explicit before/after text, never as vague suggestions
6. Present ALL proposals together and wait for user confirmation before applying any
7. If approved: apply changes using apply-safe-change, bump Last Updated on modified files, call log-action, then trigger /ai-update-index
8. If no gaps found: report 'No instruction improvements identified this session'
constraints: Never modify .ai/conventions.md, .ai/maintenance.md, .ai/credentials.md, or .ai/environment.md without strong justification — these are global canonical rules
Prefer adding to existing files over creating new .ai/instruct.md files
Never apply a proposed change without explicit user confirmation
